groups.description: When an experiment is selected, users see a detailed results view with summary cards at the top (average scores, total cost, total tokens, results count) and a paginated table below. The table shows Input, Output, Scores (as colored percentage badges), Duration, Cost, and Tokens columns. All numeric columns and individual score names are sortable. groups.description: The live evaluation panel (lazy-loaded under the 'Run Evaluation' tab) lets users run on-demand LLM-as-judge evaluations. Users provide an input (prompt/question), output (LLM response), and optional context (for RAG), select an eval spec (saved or inline JSON), and click Evaluate. Results show pass/fail badges per assertion with actual vs threshold percentages and explanatory messages. A Reset button clears the form and results.
groups.name: Live Evaluation

groups.description: The Evaluation Dashboard uses a two-panel layout where selecting items in one panel drives content in others. Selecting a dataset populates the detail panel with items and scopes the experiment list. Selecting an experiment populates the results panel. Clicking 'Evaluate' on a result row switches to the Run Evaluation tab and pre-fills the input/output fields. Tab switching between 'Experiments' and 'Run Evaluation' controls what the right panel displays.
groups.name: Cross-Panel Navigation
